summary: KE Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K with exhibits showing Next Day Disclosure Returns under HKEX rules, reporting a series of share repurchases between May 22 and June 9, 2026. The company bought back shares in both Hong Kong (HKD) and US (USD) markets, with prices ranging from HKD 42.572–45.0078 and USD 5.3035–5.7561 per share. Total repurchased shares were not cancelled as of the closing date. The filing also noted an upcoming board meeting announcement. The buyback program reflects ongoing capital return activities. Watch for continued repurchases and potential cancellation of repurchased shares, which could support share price.
